security_capabilities_verified: Hardenized Docker Compose specification with pinned OCI digest for WAHA (sha256:527ff3d6...), zero privileged mode, zero SYS_ADMIN, loopback port binding (127.0.0.1:3000), and named persistent volume

Tenant-first ChannelInstanceRepository supporting multi-line active configurations per workspace, strictly prohibiting adminPool bypass and verifying RLS isolation with indistinguishable enumeration timing oracles
Explicit instance routing in ChannelDispatchService strictly requiring (workspaceId, channelInstanceId), with fail-closed semantics and zero automatic silent fallback between providers
Allowlisted non-PII evidence reporting in ChannelHealthService eliminating leaked WhatsApp JIDs, tokens, and raw error messages

Hardened smoke test script eliminating shell string interpolation via execFileAsync and guaranteeing execution of container cleanup in finally block with distinct exit codes (0 for pass, 1 for fail, 2 for blocked external)
Atomic CTE with pessimistic FOR UPDATE lock in markPostSendReconciliationRequired eliminating Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) concurrency regressions
Strict monotonic transition protection preventing terminal states (sent, dead_letter) from being regressed to reconciliation_required by late compensation handlers
Deterministic worker lease fencing rejecting state mutations with ownership_lost upon lease theft or expiration
Canonical preservation of confirmed external_message_id without overwriting with null, blank, or placeholder identifiers

Fail-closed dispatcher compensation handling in OutboxDispatcher: already_sent -> idempotent success, already_dead_letter -> failed, ownership_lost -> FencingViolationError (zero blind resend), invalid_state -> fail-closed error

PostgreSQL real-clock fencing (lease_until >= clock_timestamp()) enforced across markProcessing, markSent, markRetryableFailure, markPermanentFailure, and markReconciliationRequired, preventing heartbeat resurrection of expired leases

Canonical Truth-in-Data post-send contract: PostSendReconciliationOutcome transports { outcome, persistedExternalMessageId, persistedStatus }, returning canonical persisted ID from PostgreSQL on already_sent, failing closed on missing ID (DATA_INCONSISTENCY), and logging divergence

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Serviço WAHA hermético configurado em docker-compose.yml com digest fixado por SHA-256, sem privilégios elevados, porta restrita a 127.0.0.1:3000 e volume persistente.
ChannelInstanceRepository gerencia instâncias tenant-safe com suporte a multi-line e resolução determinística por channelInstanceId sem seleção arbitrária de primeira linha.
ChannelDispatchService despacha mensagens com roteamento explícito, sem fallback silencioso entre provedores e com redação estrita de PII em logs e erros.
ChannelHealthService avalia saúde operacional baseado exclusivamente em evidência técnica allowlisted, sem vazar JIDs de sessão ou mensagens brutas de erro.
Script de smoke test Docker elimina command injection usando execFileAsync com arrays literais e executa limpeza atômica em bloco finally.
markPostSendReconciliationRequired executa CTE atômica com lock FOR UPDATE, garantindo monotonicidade absoluta contra regressão de sent/dead_letter, fencing de lease e 5 retornos explícitos.
OutboxDispatcher trata os 5 retornos pós-envio sem falsear sucesso em memória e lança FencingViolationError em caso de lease roubada, prevenindo reenvio cego.
Suíte hermética do monorepo aprova 35 arquivos e 536 testes com exit code 0 e 100% de sucesso nos 6 portões de qualidade (pnpm ci:check).
Fencing de expiração de lease no relógio real do PostgreSQL impede renovação por heartbeat de leases expiradas e retorno de já enviado devolve o ID canônico persistido sob Truth in Data.
